Acme Corp cut their order-processing time from four days to one afternoon. Here is how.

The bottleneck was a handoff: sales entered orders in one system, operations re-typed them into another. About 8% of orders picked up an error in the re-typing, and every error meant a customer call.

Acme connected the two systems through our API in March. The integration took their two engineers eleven days, most of it spent mapping legacy product codes. Since then, 14,000 orders have flowed through without manual entry, and the error rate on new orders sits at 0.3%.

The lesson their COO draws: fix the handoff before buying anything new.
